material.acceptance_criteria: At devicePixelRatio 1 and 2 a 100 CSS px drag moves the target the same world distance; panCamera receives the CSS viewport height, or pan converts deltas to device px.
material.description: play.js:1227-1228 takes dx/dy from clientX/clientY (CSS px) and calls renderer3d.pan. render3d.js:556 pan() passes gl.drawingBufferHeight as viewportHeightPx, and panCamera (render3d.js:211) divides the visible height by it. The canvas backing store is innerHeight*devicePixelRatio (play.js:1101-1103), so at DPR 2 the ground moves half the pointer distance. Keyboard pan (play.js:1097) uses the same path.
